title: Report: Commanders dismissed TE coach Ben Steele for violating team policy

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Commanders dismissed TE coach Ben Steele for violating team policy
sources.description: The Commanders announced the departure of tight ends coach Ben Steele on Monday morning and declined further comment about why the offseason addition to Dan Quinn's staff was leaving the team just before the start of training camp.
